column2: Apple M5 Max, 18 logical cores, macOS 26.5
1920x1080 points at each capture's pixels per point; the view is Similarity2::uniform(ppp)

native = the ops lights has a shape for, drawn at the captured geometry; framed = native plus the proxies (a glyph as its quad, a mesh or text triangle as a flat polygon, a blurred or textured rect as a flat rect of its reach); absent = kinds lights cannot draw at all

fixed = an empty DrawList at the same viewport (two planes allocated zeroed and freed, never touched); touch = the same two planes allocated, every pixel written once and freed, in the mode's own threading; opsx = the list repeated 32 times through a view that moves every footprint off the frame (every per-op step, no pixel); full = the list through the real view. page_ms = touch - fixed, per_op_ns = (opsx - fixed) / (32 x ops), ops_ms = per_op_ns x ops, px_ms = full - fixed - ops_ms, per_px_ns = px_ms / visited_px, px_share = px_ms / full
serial = render_through on the calling thread, one band the height of the frame; parallel = render_through_parallel over 16-row bands on rayon's global pool of 18 threads

rep-major: every job once per rep, 7 reps after one discarded warm-up; each figure is the median over reps with min and max beside it; the render call is timed with its result dropped inside the clock
before any time is taken, every list is rendered in every mode and the bits of both planes hashed; one differing hash refuses the run with exit 3
